title: Reolink RTSP Reconnect Flap
app: Reolink, UniFi Protect, Ring, Nest Protect, Frigate, and Home Assistant security integrations streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT, webhooks, and vendor APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reolink:event event=rtsp_reconnect
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as reconnects by camera _time
| where reconnects>3
| sort - reconnects
description: Uses Reolink stream-health events telemetry to monitor daily RTSP reconnect bursts by camera in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for network or firmware issues hurting recording stability, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Reolink stream-health events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a hourly cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals daily RTSP reconnect bursts by camera so you can spot network or firmware issues hurting recording stability before it becomes annoying.
